doro.title: Doro Wat
doro.subtitle: Chicken · berbere · 12 spices
doro.story: Doro wat is what you make when someone is worth a whole day. Four onions, cooked dry until they give up their water -- that is the whole secret, and it cannot be hurried. In much of Ethiopia it is the dish that ends a fast, carried to the table whole, the eggs scored so the sauce gets inside.
doro.storyAm: ዶሮ ወጥ የሚሠራው አንድ ሰው ሙሉ ቀን የሚያስወጣ ሲሆን ነው። አራት ሽንኩርት፣ ውሃቸውን እስኪለቁ ድረስ በደረቁ ይበስላሉ -- ሚስጥሩ ይህ ብቻ ነው፣ ማፋጠንም አይቻልም። በአብዛኛው ኢትዮጵያ ጾም የሚፈታበት ምግብ ነው፤ እንቁላሎቹ ወጡ እንዲገባባቸው ተተልትለው ይቀርባሉ።

steps.text: Dice four red onions as fine as you can stand. No oil yet.
steps.textAm: አራት ቀይ ሽንኩርት በተቻለ መጠን በጥሩ ይክተፉ። ገና ዘይት አይጨመርም።

steps.text: Dry-cook them in a bare pan until they collapse and darken.
steps.textAm: በባዶ ድስት እስኪለሰልሱና እስኪጠቁሩ ድረስ በደረቁ ያብስሏቸው።
steps.tip: No oil until the onions give up their water.

steps.text: Add the niter kibbeh. Let it melt all the way through.
steps.textAm: ንጥር ቅቤውን ይጨምሩ። ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲቀልጥ ያድርጉ።

steps.text: Stir in the berbere and cook it out — eight minutes, low.
steps.textAm: በርበሬውን ይጨምሩና ያብስሉት — ስምንት ደቂቃ፣ በዝቅተኛ እሳት።

steps.text: Add garlic and ginger paste. It should smell sharp, not raw.
steps.textAm: ነጭ ሽንኩርትና ዝንጅብል ይጨምሩ። ሽታው ጥሬ ሳይሆን ጥርት ያለ ይሁን።

steps.text: Add the chicken and turn every piece until it is coated.
steps.textAm: ዶሮውን ይጨምሩና እያንዳንዱ ቁራጭ እስኪለበስ ድረስ ይገልብጡ።

steps.text: Simmer 45 minutes. Add water only if the pan catches.
steps.textAm: ለ45 ደቂቃ ያንተከትኩ። ውሃ የሚጨመረው ድስቱ ሲይዝ ብቻ ነው።

steps.text: Score the boiled eggs and slide them in whole.
Rest ten minutes. Serve on injera with ayib.
steps.textAm: ለአሥር ደቂቃ ያሳርፉ። ከአይብ ጋር በእንጀራ ያቅርቡ።

shiro.title: Shiro
shiro.subtitle: Chickpea flour · garlic · kibbeh
shiro.story: Ground chickpea flour cooked into a loose, savoury stew. The dish most often described as the everyday meal -- fast to make, and eaten across the country in both fasting and non-fasting versions.
shiro.storyAm: የተፈጨ የሽምብራ ዱቄት ተቀቅሎ የሚሠራ ወጥ ነው። በየቀኑ የሚበላ ምግብ ተብሎ የሚጠራው ሲሆን በፍጥነት ይዘጋጃል፤ በጾምና ከጾም ውጭ በሁለቱም ይሠራል።

steps.text: Dice the onion fine and cook it down in oil.
Add crushed garlic and cook another minute.
steps.textAm: የተወቀጠ ነጭ ሽንኩርት ጨምረው አንድ ደቂቃ ያብስሉ።

steps.text: Whisk the shiro powder into cold water until smooth.
steps.textAm: የሽሮ ዱቄቱን በቀዝቃዛ ውሃ ለስላሳ እስኪሆን ያማስሉ።

steps.text: Pour it in slowly, stirring the whole time.
Simmer until it thickens and loses its raw taste.

tibs.title: Tibs
tibs.subtitle: Beef · rosemary · awaze
tibs.story: Meat cut small and seared hard and fast, often finished at the table on a clay brazier so it keeps sizzling while it is eaten.
tibs.storyAm: ሥጋው ትንሽ ተቆርጦ በከፍተኛ እሳት በፍጥነት ይጠበሳል፤ ብዙ ጊዜ በሸክላ ምድጃ ላይ እየተንተከተከ ማዕድ ላይ ይቀርባል።

steps.text: Get the pan hot enough that the meat hisses on contact.
steps.textAm: ሥጋው ሲነካ ድምፅ እስኪያሰማ ድስቱን ያሙቁት።

steps.text: Sear the beef in batches. Crowding it will steam it.
steps.textAm: ሥጋውን በየተራ ይጥበሱ። ቢበዛ በእንፋሎት ይበስላል።

steps.text: Add kibbeh, onion, rosemary and chilli.
Toss until the onion is just softened, no further.

misir.title: Misir Wat
misir.subtitle: Red lentils · berbere
misir.story: Red lentils cooked down with berbere until they hold their shape on the spoon. A fasting-table anchor.
misir.storyAm: ቀይ ምስር በበርበሬ ተብስሎ በማንኪያ ላይ እስኪቆም ድረስ ይበስላል። የጾም ማዕድ ዋነኛ ምግብ ነው።

steps.text: Rinse the lentils until the water runs clear.
Dry-cook the onions until they collapse and darken.
Add oil and berbere and cook the spice out.
Add lentils and water; simmer until thick.

injera.title: Injera
injera.subtitle: Teff · three-day ferment
injera.story: Teff batter left to ferment for days, then poured in a spiral onto a hot mitad. The sourness comes from time, not from an ingredient -- which is why it cannot be hurried.
injera.storyAm: የጤፍ ሊጥ ለቀናት ካሸተ በኋላ በሙቅ ምጣድ ላይ በጥቅል ይፈስሳል። ጎምዛዛነቱ ከጊዜ እንጂ ከግብዓት አይመጣም -- ስለዚህ ማፋጠን አይቻልም።

steps.text: Mix teff flour and water into a smooth batter.
steps.textAm: የጤፍ ዱቄትና ውሃ አዋህደው ለስላሳ ሊጥ ያድርጉ።

steps.text: Cover loosely and leave it to ferment. Day one.
steps.textAm: በላላ ሸፍነው እንዲያሽት ይተዉት። አንደኛ ቀን።

steps.text: Day two: it should smell sour and show bubbles.
steps.textAm: ሁለተኛ ቀን፡ ጎምዛዛ ሽታና አረፋ ሊኖረው ይገባል።

steps.text: Day three: pour off the water that has risen on top.
steps.textAm: ሦስተኛ ቀን፡ ላይ የወጣውን ውሃ ያፍስሱ።

steps.text: Cook a little absit, stir it back in, rest an hour.
steps.textAm: ትንሽ አብሲት አብስለው መልሰው ይቀላቅሉና አንድ ሰዓት ያሳርፉ።

steps.text: Pour in a spiral from the outside in onto a hot mitad.
steps.textAm: በሙቅ ምጣድ ላይ ከዳር ወደ መሃል በጥቅል ያፍሱ።

steps.text: Cover until the eyes set. Do not turn it.

kitfo.title: Kitfo
kitfo.subtitle: Minced beef · mitmita · ayib
kitfo.story: Beef minced very fine and warmed -- not cooked -- through spiced butter and mitmita. Associated with Gurage cooking, and traditionally eaten the day the animal is slaughtered.
kitfo.storyAm: ሥጋው በጣም በጥሩ ተከትፎ በቅመም ቅቤና በሚጥሚጣ ይሞቃል እንጂ አይበስልም። ከጉራጌ ምግብ ጋር የተያያዘ ሲሆን በባህሉ እንስሳው በታረደበት ቀን ይበላል።

steps.text: Mince the beef by hand, as fine as you can manage.
steps.textAm: ሥጋውን በእጅ በተቻለ መጠን በጥሩ ይክተፉት።

steps.text: Warm the kibbeh until it is liquid but not hot.
Work the kibbeh and mitmita through the meat.
Serve at once, with ayib and gomen alongside.

gomen.title: Gomen
gomen.subtitle: Collards · ginger · garlic
gomen.story: Collard greens cooked slowly with ginger and garlic until they give up their bite.
gomen.storyAm: ጎመን ከዝንጅብልና ከነጭ ሽንኩርት ጋር ጠንካራነቱን እስኪለቅ ድረስ በእርጋታ ይበስላል።

steps.text: Strip the leaves from the stems and shred them.
Blanch briefly, then drain well.
Soften onion, ginger and garlic in oil.
steps.textAm: ሽንኩርት፣ ዝንጅብልና ነጭ ሽንኩርት በዘይት ያለሰልሱ።

steps.text: Add the greens and cook down slowly.

buna.title: Buna Ceremony
buna.subtitle: Roast · grind · three rounds
buna.story: The coffee ceremony: green beans roasted, ground and brewed in front of the people who will drink them, served in three rounds. It is not a fast process, and it is not meant to be.
buna.storyAm: የቡና ሥነ ሥርዓት፡ ጥሬ ቡና በሚጠጡት ሰዎች ፊት ተቁሎ፣ ተፈጭቶና ተፈልቶ በሦስት ዙር ይቀርባል። ፈጣን ሂደት አይደለም፤ እንዲሆንም አልታሰበም።

steps.text: Wash the green beans and set the incense burning.
Roast the beans in a flat pan, shaking constantly.
Carry the pan around so everyone takes the smoke.
Grind the roasted beans by hand.
Brew in the jebena and let it rise without boiling over.
Pour the first round from a height, in one go.
steps.textAm: የመጀመሪያውን ዙር ከከፍታ በአንድ ጊዜ ያፍሱ።

beyay.title: Beyaynetu
beyay.subtitle: Seven fasting dishes, one plate
beyay.story: Not one dish but a plate of them -- shiro, misir, gomen, kik and more, arranged on injera so no two mouthfuls are the same. The fasting table at its fullest.
beyay.storyAm: አንድ ምግብ ሳይሆን የብዙ ምግቦች ማዕድ ነው -- ሽሮ፣ ምስር፣ ጎመን፣ ክክና ሌሎችም በእንጀራ ላይ ተደርድረው ሁለት ጉርሻ አንድ ዓይነት እንዳይሆን። የጾም ማዕድ በሙላቱ።

steps.text: Plan backwards from serving time -- the slow dishes start first.
steps.textAm: ከማቅረቢያ ሰዓት ወደኋላ ያቅዱ -- ዘገምተኛዎቹ መጀመሪያ ይጀምራሉ።

steps.text: Start misir and kik, which take the longest.
steps.textAm: ረጅም ጊዜ የሚወስዱትን ምስርና ክክ ይጀምሩ።

steps.text: Cook gomen and atakilt while those simmer.
Make the shiro last, so it is still loose.
Lay injera and spoon each dish into its own place.
steps.textAm: እንጀራ አንጥፈው እያንዳንዱን ምግብ በየቦታው ያድርጉ።

firfir.title: Firfir
firfir.subtitle: Torn injera · awaze · kibbeh
firfir.story: Injera torn up and stirred through a spiced sauce -- the dish that turns yesterday's bread into today's breakfast.
firfir.storyAm: እንጀራ ተቀዶ በቅመም መረቅ ይቀላቀላል -- የትናንቱን እንጀራ የዛሬ ቁርስ የሚያደርግ ምግብ ነው።

steps.text: Tear the injera into small pieces.
Cook onion in oil, then add berbere and tomato.
steps.textAm: ሽንኩርቱን በዘይት አብስለው በርበሬና ቲማቲም ይጨምሩ።

steps.text: Toss the torn injera through until evenly coated.

kik.title: Kik Alicha
kik.subtitle: Split peas · turmeric
kik.story: Yellow split peas cooked with turmeric and no chilli -- the mild dish on a fasting plate that otherwise runs hot.
kik.storyAm: ክክ በእርድ ተብስሎ ያለ በርበሬ ይሠራል -- በሌላው ሁሉ በሚያቃጥል የጾም ማዕድ ላይ ለስላሳው ምግብ ነው።

steps.text: Soak the split peas, then rinse them.
Soften onion in oil with turmeric and garlic.
steps.textAm: ሽንኩርቱን ከእርድና ከነጭ ሽንኩርት ጋር በዘይት ያለሰልሱ።

steps.text: Add peas and water; simmer until they break down.

dulet.title: Dulet
dulet.subtitle: Tripe · liver · mitmita
dulet.story: Finely chopped tripe, liver and lean meat, warmed through spiced butter and mitmita. Ordered by people who know exactly what they want.
dulet.storyAm: ጨጓራ፣ ጉበትና ቀጭን ሥጋ በጥሩ ተከትፎ በቅመም ቅቤና በሚጥሚጣ ይሞቃል። የሚፈልጉትን በትክክል በሚያውቁ ሰዎች ይታዘዛል።

steps.text: Clean the tripe thoroughly and chop everything very fine.
steps.textAm: ጨጓራውን በደንብ አጽድተው ሁሉንም በጣም በጥሩ ይክተፉ።

steps.text: Warm the kibbeh with onion until fragrant.
steps.textAm: ቅቤውን ከሽንኩርት ጋር ሽታው እስኪወጣ ያሙቁት።

steps.text: Add the meats and warm through briefly.
Stir in mitmita and serve immediately.

chechebsa.title: Chechebsa
chechebsa.subtitle: Torn flatbread · niter kibbeh · berbere
chechebsa.story: A breakfast of torn flatbread tossed in spiced butter, eaten in many Oromo homes with yoghurt or honey alongside. It is quick by design -- the bread is made, torn and dressed in the same morning.
chechebsa.storyAm: የተቀደደ ቂጣ በቅመም ቅቤ ተለውሶ የሚበላ ቁርስ ሲሆን በብዙ የኦሮሞ ቤቶች ከእርጎ ወይም ከማር ጋር ይቀርባል። በአንድ ጠዋት ተሠርቶ ተቀዶ ይዘጋጃል።

steps.text: Make a plain kita and let it cool enough to handle.
Tear it into rough pieces the size of a thumbnail.
Melt the niter kibbeh in a wide pan over low heat.
steps.textAm: ንጥር ቅቤውን በሰፊ ድስት በዝቅተኛ እሳት ያቅልጡት።

steps.text: Stir in the berbere and let it bloom without burning.
Toss the torn bread through until every piece is coated.
steps.textAm: የተቀደደውን ቂጣ እያንዳንዱ ቁራጭ እስኪለበስ ይቀላቅሉ።

steps.text: Serve hot, with honey or yoghurt if you like.
steps.textAm: ሙቅ ሆኖ ከማር ወይም ከእርጎ ጋር ያቅርቡ።

genfo.title: Genfo
genfo.subtitle: Barley porridge · kibbeh well · berbere
genfo.story: A stiff barley porridge shaped into a mound with a well of spiced butter in the middle. Often served to new mothers and on cold mornings, it is eaten from the outside in.
genfo.storyAm: የገብስ ገንፎ ተከምሮ መሃሉ ላይ የቅመም ቅቤ ጉድጓድ ይሠራለታል። ብዙ ጊዜ ለወላድ እናቶችና በቀዝቃዛ ጠዋቶች የሚቀርብ ሲሆን ከዳር ወደ መሃል ይበላል።

steps.text: Bring the salted water to a rolling boil.
Add the barley flour all at once and stop stirring.
steps.textAm: የገብስ ዱቄቱን በአንድ ጊዜ ጨምረው ማማሰሉን ያቁሙ።

steps.text: Cover and let it steam through.
Beat it hard with a wooden spoon until smooth and stiff.
steps.textAm: በእንጨት ማንኪያ ለስላሳና ጠጣር እስኪሆን ድረስ ይምቱት።

steps.text: Shape into a mound and press a well into the centre.
steps.textAm: ክምር አድርገው መሃሉ ላይ ጉድጓድ ይሥሩ።

steps.text: Melt the kibbeh with berbere and pour it into the well.
steps.textAm: ቅቤውን ከበርበሬ ጋር አቅልጠው ጉድጓዱ ውስጥ ያፍሱ።

atakilt.title: Atakilt Wat
atakilt.subtitle: Cabbage · carrot · potato · turmeric
atakilt.story: A gentle turmeric-yellow vegetable stew with no berbere at all, which is what makes it a fasting-table staple and a good first dish for anyone wary of heat.
atakilt.storyAm: በእርድ የሚቀላ ለስላሳ የአትክልት ወጥ ሲሆን በርበሬ አልያዘም። ለጾም ማዕድ ዋነኛ ሲሆን ቅመም ለሚፈሩ ሰዎችም ጥሩ መጀመሪያ ነው።

steps.text: Slice the onion and soften it in oil.
Add garlic and turmeric and stir for a minute.
steps.textAm: ነጭ ሽንኩርትና እርድ ጨምረው ለአንድ ደቂቃ ያማስሉ።

steps.text: Add carrots and potatoes cut into thick batons.
steps.textAm: ካሮትና ድንቹን ወፍራም አድርገው ቆርጠው ይጨምሩ።

steps.text: Add the shredded cabbage and a splash of water.
Cover and cook low until everything is tender.
steps.textAm: ሸፍነው ሁሉም እስኪለሰልስ በዝቅተኛ እሳት ያብስሉ።

bozena.title: Bozena Shiro
bozena.subtitle: Shiro · shredded beef · berbere
bozena.story: Shiro with meat stirred through it -- the version cooked when a fast has ended and there is dried beef in the house.
bozena.storyAm: ሥጋ የተጨመረበት ሽሮ ሲሆን ጾም ሲፈታና በቤት ውስጥ ቋንጣ ሲኖር የሚሠራው ዓይነት ነው።

steps.text: Dry-cook the diced onion until it collapses.
Add kibbeh and berbere and cook the spice out.
Add the shredded dried beef and turn it through.
Whisk the shiro powder into water, then pour it in slowly.
steps.textAm: የሽሮ ዱቄቱን በውሃ አማስለው ቀስ ብለው ያፍሱት።

steps.text: Simmer, stirring, until it thickens and stops tasting raw.

fosolia.title: Fosolia
fosolia.subtitle: Green beans · carrot · garlic
fosolia.story: Green beans and carrots cooked down with onion and garlic. A quiet dish that shares the fasting plate with louder ones.
fosolia.storyAm: ፎሶሊያና ካሮት ከሽንኩርትና ነጭ ሽንኩርት ጋር የሚበስል ነው። ጸጥ ያለ ምግብ ሲሆን በጾም ማዕድ ላይ ከሌሎች ጋር ይቀርባል።

steps.text: Top and tail the beans; cut the carrots to match.
steps.textAm: የፎሶሊያውን ጫፍ ቆርጠው ካሮቱን በተመሳሳይ ይቁረጡ።

steps.text: Soften the sliced onion in oil.
Add garlic, then the vegetables.
Cover and cook until tender but still green.
steps.textAm: ሸፍነው እስኪለሰልሱ ግን አረንጓዴነታቸውን ሳይለቁ ያብስሉ።

alicha.title: Alicha Wat
alicha.subtitle: Beef · turmeric · no berbere
alicha.story: The mild counterpart to a berbere wat: turmeric instead of chilli, cooked long and gently. Often the dish put in front of children and elders at the same table.
alicha.storyAm: የበርበሬ ወጥ ለስላሳ አቻ ሲሆን በርበሬ ሳይሆን እርድ ይጠቀማል፤ ረጅም ጊዜ በእርጋታ ይበስላል። ብዙ ጊዜ በአንድ ማዕድ ላይ ለልጆችና ለአዛውንቶች የሚቀርበው ነው።

steps.text: Dry-cook the onions until soft and pale.
Add kibbeh, turmeric, garlic and ginger.
steps.textAm: ቅቤ፣ እርድ፣ ነጭ ሽንኩርትና ዝንጅብል ይጨምሩ።

steps.text: Add the beef and turn until sealed.
Add water to barely cover and simmer low.
steps.textAm: ውሃ ሸፍኖት እስኪያልፍ ጨምረው በዝቅተኛ እሳት ያንተከትኩ።

ayib.title: Ayib
ayib.subtitle: Fresh cheese · pressed curd
ayib.story: A mild fresh cheese, crumbly and barely salted. Its job is to sit next to something fierce -- kitfo, or a hot wat -- and cool it down.
ayib.storyAm: ለስላሳና ትንሽ ጨው ያለው ትኩስ አይብ ነው። ሥራው ከሚያቃጥል ምግብ -- ከክትፎ ወይም ከሚያቃጥል ወጥ -- አጠገብ ሆኖ ማብረድ ነው።

steps.text: Warm the buttermilk gently. Do not let it boil.
Let the curds separate and rise.
Strain through cloth and press out the whey.
Salt lightly and serve cool.
steps.textAm: ትንሽ ጨው ጨምረው ቀዝቃዛ ሆኖ ያቅርቡ።

awaze.title: Awaze
awaze.subtitle: Berbere · wine · garlic paste
awaze.story: A berbere paste loosened with wine or tej, served beside tibs and kitfo for anyone who wants more heat than the dish already carries.
awaze.storyAm: በወይን ወይም በጠጅ የተለወሰ የበርበሬ ለጥ ሲሆን ከምግቡ በላይ ቅመም ለሚፈልጉ ከጥብስና ከክትፎ ጎን ይቀርባል።

steps.text: Crush the garlic to a paste with a little salt.
steps.textAm: ነጭ ሽንኩርቱን ከትንሽ ጨው ጋር ወቅጠው ለጥ ያድርጉት።

steps.text: Stir the berbere into the wine a spoon at a time.
steps.textAm: በርበሬውን በማንኪያ እየጨመሩ ከወይኑ ጋር ያማስሉ።

steps.text: Rest it so the spice softens before serving.

tihlo.title: Tihlo
tihlo.subtitle: Roasted barley dough · fork-eaten
tihlo.story: Balls of roasted barley dough, speared on a small wooden fork and dipped in a spiced sauce. Associated with Tigray, and eaten communally from one dish.
tihlo.storyAm: የተጠበሰ የገብስ ሊጥ ኳስ ሲሆን በትንሽ የእንጨት ሹካ ተወግቶ በቅመም መረቅ ይጠቀሳል። ከትግራይ ጋር የተያያዘ ሲሆን ከአንድ ሰሃን በጋራ ይበላል።

steps.text: Work the flour and warm water into a stiff dough.
steps.textAm: ዱቄቱንና ለብ ያለ ውሃ አዋህደው ጠጣር ሊጥ ያድርጉት።

steps.text: Roll it into small balls and keep them covered.
Build a berbere sauce with kibbeh and onion.
Serve the balls around the sauce, with forks.
steps.textAm: ኳሶቹን በመረቁ ዙሪያ ከሹካ ጋር ያቅርቡ።

shorba.title: Shorba
shorba.subtitle: Lentil broth · cumin · fast-breaking
shorba.story: A thin lentil broth, often the first thing eaten when a fast is broken because it is gentle on an empty stomach.
shorba.storyAm: ቀጭን የምስር ሾርባ ሲሆን ባዶ ሆድ ላይ ቀላል ስለሆነ ጾም ሲፈታ መጀመሪያ የሚበላ ነው።

steps.text: Soften onion in oil with the cumin.
Add chopped tomato and let it break down.
Add lentils and plenty of water.
Simmer until the lentils fall apart.

kinche.title: Kinche
kinche.subtitle: Cracked wheat · kibbeh · plain
kinche.story: Cracked wheat boiled soft and dressed with spiced butter. Plain on purpose -- a breakfast that does not compete with the coffee that follows it.
kinche.storyAm: የተፈጨ ስንዴ ለስላሳ እስኪሆን ተቀቅሎ በቅመም ቅቤ ይለወሳል። ሆን ተብሎ ተራ ነው -- ከሚከተለው ቡና ጋር የማይወዳደር ቁርስ።

steps.text: Rinse the cracked wheat until the water runs clear.
Boil in salted water until soft.
Drain, then stir the kibbeh through while hot.

ful.title: Ful
ful.subtitle: Fava beans · onion · chilli · bread
ful.story: Stewed fava beans mashed at the table, eaten from a shared bowl with bread. Common in Harar and across the east, and a fixture of morning eating houses.
ful.storyAm: የበሰለ ባቄላ በማዕድ ላይ ተፈጭቶ ከዳቦ ጋር ከጋራ ሰሃን ይበላል። በሐረርና በምሥራቁ አካባቢ የተለመደ ሲሆን የጠዋት ምግብ ቤቶች ዋነኛ ነው።

steps.text: Warm the beans through with a little of their liquid.
Mash roughly -- it should not be smooth.
steps.textAm: ሻካራ አድርገው ይፍጩት -- ለስላሳ መሆን የለበትም።

steps.text: Top with raw onion, chilli, tomato and oil.
steps.textAm: ጥሬ ሽንኩርት፣ ቃሪያ፣ ቲማቲምና ዘይት ይጨምሩበት።

steps.text: Serve with bread torn to scoop.

dabo.title: Ambasha
dabo.subtitle: Celebration bread · scored top
dabo.story: A round, slightly sweet bread scored across the top before baking. Made for holidays and guests; the pattern is cut so it can be torn into even shares.
dabo.storyAm: ክብ፣ ትንሽ ጣፋጭ ዳቦ ሲሆን ከመጋገሩ በፊት ላዩ ላይ ይቀረጻል። ለበዓላትና ለእንግዶች የሚሠራ ሲሆን እኩል ለመከፋፈል እንዲመች ነው የሚቀረጸው።

steps.text: Bloom the yeast in warm water with the sugar.
steps.textAm: እርሾውን ከስኳር ጋር በለብ ያለ ውሃ ያንቁት።

steps.text: Work everything into a soft dough and knead it well.
steps.textAm: ሁሉንም አዋህደው ለስላሳ ሊጥ አድርገው በደንብ ያቡኩት።

steps.text: Let it rise until doubled.
Shape into a round and score the pattern across the top.
steps.textAm: ክብ አድርገው ላዩ ላይ ንድፍ ይቅረጹ።

steps.text: Bake until it sounds hollow underneath.
